title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1029 | 吃水果的恐龙、冥王星外新世界、巨型漫画书
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦖 科学家发现了一种爱吃水果的恐龙，它长着羽毛、没有牙齿，却有个能捣碎软水果的强壮下巴！
🪐 科学家在冥王星之外发现了一个冰冷的新世界，它有德克萨斯州那么大，离太阳比地球远四十六倍！
📚 世界上最大的漫画书诞生了！它有一米多高、重得像块砖，全世界只有五十五本！

📖 Word of the day: dwarf（比同类小很多的）

🎮 猜谜时间：我比你的书包还高、重得像块砖，还会用图画讲故事——我是谁？答案：巨型漫画书！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦖 Scientists found a dinosaur that loved fruit — feathered, toothless, but with strong jaws for mashing soft fruit!
🪐 Scientists found a brand new icy world beyond Pluto, about the size of Texas and forty-six times farther from the sun than Earth!
📚 The world's largest comic book is here — more than one meter tall, as heavy as a brick, with only fifty-five copies made!

📖 Word of the day: dwarf

🎮 Riddle time: I am taller than your school bag, I weigh as much as a brick, and I tell a story in pictures — what am I? The giant comic book!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. dwarf（比同类小很多的）
something much smaller than usual of its kind
例：a dwarf planet（矮行星）

2. munch（大口嚼）
to chew something noisily and with enthusiasm
例：munch fruit all day（整天大口嚼水果）

3. spot（发现；注意到）
to see or notice something, especially after looking
例：a giant camera spotted it（巨型相机发现了它）

4. comic（漫画书）
a book that tells a story in pictures
例：a giant comic book（巨型漫画书）
